errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are not all municipalities ('общини'). They include 'Общо за страната' (Total for the country) and 'Северозападен район' (Northwestern region), which are not municipalities.
The chart label is 'Видин', not 'Будин'. The description misspells the category name.
The description lists all six categories shown on the x-axis, so adding 'и др.' (etc.) is incorrect as there are no other categories.
The value for 'Общо за страната' in 2016 is approximately 315 BGN, not 280 BGN.
The value for 'Общо за страната' in 2020 is approximately 460 BGN, not 380 BGN.
The value for 'Монтана' in 2016 is approximately 250 BGN, not 210 BGN.
The value for 'Монтана' in 2020 is approximately 280 BGN, not 300 BGN.
